sentences.englishText: And what to do with the results of the harvest?
Again, we look to Mother Nature: she shares everything with everyone.
sentences.turkishText: Tekrar, biz Doğa Anaya bakarız, o her şeyi herkesle paylaşır.

sentences.englishText: An artist who wishes to keep his work to himself, is not being fair with that which he/she received from the present moment, nor with the inheritance and teachings of his forefathers.
sentences.turkishText: İşini kendi başına devam ettirmek isteyen sanatkâr, ne şu an elde ettiği, ne de miras kalan ve atalarının öğretileri konusunda adil olmuş değildir.

sentences.englishText: If we leave the grain stored in the granary, it will go bad, even though it was harvested at the right time.
sentences.turkishText: Doğru zamanda hasat edilse bile, eğer tahılı ambarda saklarsak, kötüye gider.

sentences.englishText: When the harvest is over, the time comes to share, without fear or shame, your own soul.
sentences.turkishText: Hasat bittiğinde, vakit kendi özünü, endişe ve utanma olmadan paylaşma vaktidir.
